bull_case: 경영진은 Reels·AI 전환과 비용 구조 재설계로 2023~26 성장을 재가속했고, 2025년까지 대규모 자사주·배당을 병행했다. 광고 AI의 성과와 비즈니스 메시징 확장은 자본 재배치의 결과를 보여준다.
bear_case: Zuckerberg가 약 60.8% 의결권을 통제해 외부 주주의 견제가 제한된다. 2026년 초대형 AI 인프라·장기 리스 약정과 Reality Labs 손실은 성공 시 큰 옵션이지만 실패 시 자본배분 오류의 규모도 매우 크다.
thesis: 실행 적응력은 75지만 자본배분과 거버넌스가 총점을 제한한다. 최근 4개 분기 중 실질 자사주 매입은 Q3 2025에 집중됐고 평균 약 $711/주로 EV Base $638 대비 약 1.11배여서 관측표 55점이다. 2026 proxy에서 Zuckerberg의 총 의결권이 60.8%로 확인돼 governance는 50점으로 둔다. 회계 재작성·감사인 이견 같은 신뢰성 훼손 사건은 확인되지 않아 Hard Veto는 clear다.

evidence.claim: In Q3 2025 Meta repurchased 4.444M shares for about $3.16B, an average near $711/share; there were no repurchases in H1 2026. Versus locked Base value $638.42, the observed buyback price/Base ratio is ~1.11x.
The 2026 proxy reports Mark Zuckerberg with approximately 60.8% of total voting power, reflecting a material dual-class governance concentration.
2025 revenue grew 22%, DAP grew 7% in December, ad impressions rose 12% and average price per ad rose 9% as Meta scaled Reels and AI-driven recommendation/ads.
At Q2 2026 Meta disclosed $349.31B of non-cancelable contractual commitments and $278.99B of uncommenced leases, making current AI infrastructure allocation unusually large and path-dependent.

counterevidence: Reality Labs losses remain near a $20B annual run-rate.
AI infrastructure commitments are unprecedented relative to historical balance sheet flexibility.
Recent buybacks were not at a clear discount to the harness Base value.
unknowns: The long-run realized return on 2026 AI infrastructure commitments cannot yet be observed.
falsifiers: AI infrastructure spending fails to produce durable revenue/FCF growth by 2028.
Reality Labs losses rise materially without adoption or monetization evidence.
A restatement, material weakness, auditor dispute or undisclosed related-party issue emerges.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손
hard_veto_flags.rationale: The reviewed filings and 2026 proxy do not identify a restatement, auditor disagreement/change, material internal-control weakness or undisclosed related-party event that establishes an integrity/accounting-reliability breach.

next_checks: Update buyback-price test if repurchases resume.
Track realized returns on infrastructure commitments.

subscores.rationale: Recent repurchases averaged roughly $711/share, about 1.11x the locked Base value of $638.42. Band-centre interpolation in the 1.0~1.2 row rounds to 55, so capital allocation is not credited as value-accretive at a clear discount.

The 50 'ordinary risk' anchor captures unusually concentrated 60.8% founder voting control without evidence of accounting unreliability. 75 is excluded because minority-shareholder checks are structurally weak; 25 is excluded because no integrity breach is established.

Reels/AI product shifts and 2025-26 monetization growth demonstrate successful adaptation, matching 75. 90 is excluded because Reality Labs and the new AI-capex program have not yet proven long-run returns.

uncertainties.rationale: The return on unprecedented AI infrastructure commitments will dominate the future capital-allocation verdict.
Founder voting control reduces external corrective mechanisms even absent an integrity breach.
